minutes_text:
PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  September 12, 2019

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was held on Thursday, September 12,
2019, at 2:04 pm in the Community Room A, 1st Floor.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Eddy Ikemefuna, Planning & Building Department
  Officer Loren Robinson, Police Department
  Cpt. Reggie Johnson, LACO Fire Department
  Aisha Thompson, City Clerk’s
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer 2:25

  Staff Present:  Peggy L. Velasquez, Finance Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee,
provided the item is within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License
Committee.
Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any item on the Agenda.
Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Agenda Items

A motion was moved and seconded to approve the minutes from the meeting held on
August 22, 2019.

Permit Request (s):

Item #1:  D’Artagnan Scorza DBA Social Justice Learning Institute to host Electric
  Inglewood EVGo’s Fast Charging Grand Opening at Yola Parking Lot at
  105 S. La Brea Avenue, on Saturday, September 21, 2019, from 11:00 a.m.
  - 4:00 p.m.; 2 Uniformed Officers required to ensure safety of attendees; 4
  Traffic Control Officers (TCO’s) to ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular
  circulation on/off site; TCO’s to monitor both sides of alley allowing only EV
  Vehicles in the alley; Applicant to provide list of dignitaries that are
  expected; food truck(s) must be registered with the City and hold a valid LA
  County Health Permit; no construction during of YOLA Building during
  event; Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned
  immediately at the end of the event; adhere to all applicable Inglewood
  Municipal Code rules and regulations, including noise and signage, local,
  state and federal laws. Motion carried and second (Activity No. 00276764)

Item #2:  Diana, David and Maria DBA St. John Chrysostom Church to host St. John
  Chrysostom Church Carnival at St. John’s Church Parking Lot at 546 E.
  Florence Avenue, on Friday, October 11, 2019, from 5:00 p.m. - 10:00 p.m.;
  Saturday, October 12, 2019, from 3:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m. and Sunday,
  October 13 2019, from 10:00 a.m. to 9:30 p.m.; 5 State and City Licensed
 Permits & License Committee  September 12, 2019

  Security Guards (not armed) to ensure safety of attendees; 2 Security
  Guards are to be posted at the beer garden, NO underage alcohol
  consumption; Contact Los Angeles County Fire Department at (310) 263-
  2732, to obtain carnival, tent and/or special event permits; Carnival Midway
  Attractions is required to pay business tax fees by Monday, October 7,
  2019; IPD background investigation clearance required for all carnival
  operators, prior to the issuance of the permit, only the names listed on the
  employee roster that have cleared the background investigation, is
  permitted to work the carnival event; Inglewood Police Dept. Watch
  Commander will be notified and extra patrol will be provided as time
  permits; obtain and adhere to Public Works Permit 19-04041 requirements,
  contact Mr. Weeks to setup no-parking signs; organization shall provide
  traffic control, any person directing traffic is required to wear highly-visible
  retro-reflective vests; notify effective residents in writing 72 hours in
  advance; noise level should be kept to a minimum and no live band music
  after 9:00 p.m. Sunday night; maintain site at all times, ensuring site is
  properly cleaned immediately at the end of the event; ensure safe
  pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off site; and adhere to all applicable
  IMC regulations, including noise and signage. Motion carried and second.
  (Activity No. 00276873)

Business License Renewal Request(s):

Item #3:  A motion was moved and seconded to collectively APPROVE the following
  list of business license renewals, subject to payment of business tax;
  adhere to all applicable IMC regulations, state and federal law and standard
  business recommendation applicable to each business type, Business #1
  must provide current CHP Inspection Report and Business #3 reiterate
  “Office Use Only”. Motion carried and second.

  Business Name  Business Type  Activity
  No.
  1  California Excursion &  Bus Charter Service –  00249777
  Transportation  Inside City
  2  Allied Guard Services  Detective/Guard  00249798
  3  William S. Garcia  Used Auto Cars  00249749

Public Comments
Chairman Ikemefuna asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the
Permits & License Committee on any matters connected with items on the Agenda, it was
reported that there were no public requests to speak.

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 2:32 p.m.

  Respectfully submitted,
  Peggy L. Velasquez, Recording Secretary
